payload.text: After 2.14.3 (vc, slot 325): leg.sh's commit form passes no base to prep.sh. prep.sh's sha mode measures from merge-base(main, sha), so for a head already on main its Mac-side changed-file listing is empty (slot 325: base = candidate, 0 paths). Make the listing use leg.sh's own base. Doc before code. Not before the cut.
